envVars.name: RANCHER_CLI_CACERT

envVars.desc: credential store backend: auto, keychain, or file
envVars.name: RANCHER_CLI_CREDENTIAL_STORE

envVars.desc: when non-empty, refuse commands that make changes
envVars.name: RANCHER_CLI_READONLY

envVars.desc: local callback port for the authcode OAuth flow
envVars.name: RANCHER_CLI_OAUTH_CALLBACK_PORT

envVars.desc: base directory for the default config location
envVars.name: XDG_CONFIG_HOME

globalFlags.desc: never prompt; ambiguity becomes an error
globalFlags.name: --no-input

globalFlags.desc: scope: cluster[:project]; the :project scopes namespaced reads on downstream clusters (--project overrides it); a trailing colon (cluster:) clears it; precedence: flag, then RANCHER_CLI_CONTEXT, then config
globalFlags.name: --context

globalFlags.desc: scope operations to project namespaces (downstream namespaced resources only); flag overrides context; rejected with an error where it does not apply
globalFlags.name: --project

globalFlags.desc: refuse mutating commands for this session; one-way, no override (also: config readOnly, a non-empty RANCHER_CLI_READONLY)
globalFlags.name: --read-only
